headline.definition: Held-out 2019-2021 (fit on 2012-2018, nothing tuned on the test years). Every method is scored on the same H3 res-5 cell x month table for the same countries and years (scripts/build_heldout_errors.py). Medians are over countries. best_* = the method with the lowest MAE (highest R2) in that country. step_within_1_25 = countries whose 2012 step (mean 2012-2014 / mean Aqua 2009-2011) is within x1.25 of the step of Aqua alone, the unchanged sensor.

limits.definition: Model only, held-out 2019-2021. Countries ranked by their held-out Aqua MODIS total (2019-2021 daytime vegetation detections) and split into three equal-count groups. country_month_ape = |predicted - observed| / observed for a whole-country monthly total, median over months with observed > 0, then median over countries.

worked_example.definition: A drawn box (H3 res-4 cells whose centre is inside it, as the Explorer selects them) summed from web/public/data/area/*.parquet. Most unusual month: highest percentile within its own calendar month over 2003-2025 (share of years with a lower value), ties broken by the excess over that month's median. Historical context, not a prediction.
worked_example.label: New South Wales, Australia (it also clips the edges of Victoria, Queensland and South Australia)

step_collapse.definition: step = mean annual count 2012-2014 / mean 2009-2011 (params_global.json null_control). Aqua-only uses one unchanged sensor; raw splices MODIS (to 2011) onto VIIRS (from 2012).

benchmark.definition: Held-out 2019-2021 cell-months (H3 res-5, monthly Aqua daytime counts), fit on 2012-2018. Model, threshold and raw VIIRS from params_global.json validation_test; ratio baseline (training-only Aqua/Suomi-NPP ratio x VIIRS count) and MAE from validation_points.json.
benchmark.ratio_definition: prediction = ratio * Suomi-NPP detections in the cell-month, ratio = Aqua / Suomi-NPP detections in the country over 2012-2018 only

records.definition: For each own-fit country, calendar month and year 2012-2021: flagged as a record when the monthly count is strictly above the maximum of that calendar month over 2003-2011. raw_splice = MODIS to 2011 then VIIRS from 2012 (calendar_raw_global); modis = MODIS Terra+Aqua all years; harmonized = calendar_harmonized_global. Months with no row count as 0.

chance_reference.definition: if a year is exchangeable with the 9 baseline years (no trend, no ties), the chance it is the largest of the 10 is 1/10

seam.definition: For each own-fit country's annual series (countries.json), the candidate year y with the largest |log(mean(y..y+2) / mean(y-3..y-1))|. Candidates 2006-2019, so every window stays inside 2003-2021 (before the 2022 orbit drift). Candidates with a zero mean are skipped.
